answer.rationale: Deploy a narrowly targeted, time-limited pricing response only to demonstrably price-sensitive SMB accounts at immediate churn risk. The current competitor cut and doubled price-related churn conversations make price intervention the most directly relevant option. However, prior evidence found promotional pricing materially reduced 30-day retention, so it should not be broadly rolled out or treated as a general acquisition tactic. There is no verified evidence that it offsets competitor-driven churn over the long term; constrain eligibility and monitor retention and qualified revenue closely.
